title: 4.5.stable: `InputEventMouseMotion` dead zone around `InputEventMouseButton`
body:
### Tested versions

4.4.1.stable
4.5.stable
4.6.dev6

### System information

(after rolling back to 4.4.1.stable) Godot v4.4.1.stable - Android - Single-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - integrated Adreno (TM) 642L -  (8 threads)

### Issue description

This is for an application that uses a pressure-sensitive stylus to draw with a `Control`'s `_gui_input` method. Both tests were done in the Android editor.

In version **4.4.1.stable**, `InputEventMouseMotion` events were triggered between a quick press and release of `InputEventMouseButton`. This was desirable as it allowed tiny dots to be drawn with the `InputEventMouseMotion`'s `pressure` property, and with the subtle positional precision required for drawing. In version **4.5.stable**, there is now a dead zone around the pressed `InputEventMouseButton`, preventing any `InputEventMouseMotion`s from appearing until the stylus moves quite a far distance away from where the `InputEventMouseButton` was pressed. The issue persists in the exported application as well.

### Steps to reproduce

Print the `InputEvent` argument of a `Control`'s `_gui_input` method, then click and drag in the `Control`'s rectangle. Use a pressure-sensitive stylus if you have one.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

~N/A - I've since rolled back to 4.4.1.stable to restore functionality. Because I'm on Android, returning to 4.5.stable to produce a reproduction project will require uninstalling my current version and needing to reconfigure my editor settings and themes again.~

I was able to use a different device to create a reproduction project in **4.6.dev6**, where it's still broken:

[event-dead-zone.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24052850/event-dead-zone.zip)
